gold_points: Lease liabilities use incremental borrowing rate because leases lack readily determinable implicit rate
Research subscription revenues are deferred and recognized ratably over the contract term
Conferences revenues are recognized upon completion of the related conference
Consulting fixed fee revenue recognized as performance obligations are satisfied; contract optimization is contingent
